text_block_list.name: Violet
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, there’s a dessert recipe Yukino taught me the other day…
I was thinking of trying to make it.
Would you mind lending me a hand, Knight?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえば、
先日ユキノに教わったデザートのレシピが
ありまして……
試しに作ってみようと思うのですが、
騎士様のお手をお借りしてもよろしいでしょうか？

text_block_list.name: Violet
text_block_list.text:
This recipe apparently has medicinal effects that are good for the throat.
By adding an appropriate amount of ice from the Eternal Glacier, along with fruit, herbs, and sugar—
text_block_list.orig_text:
このレシピは、
なんと
喉に良い薬膳のような効能もあるのです。
久遠氷河の氷を適量に、
果物に薬草、
砂糖などを加えれば──
